scenarios.assertion: Same idempotency key and body returns the same message/run/attempt receipt.
Same key with changed body is rejected with 409 idempotency_conflict.
Retry replay returns one attempt receipt; stale revision cannot create a fresh run.
Queued run is cancelled and cancellation is observable in events.
Unknown provider outcome is retained without automatic replay, including usage.
Injected vector failure falls back within the same item boundary.

limitations: Uses isolated test fixtures and controlled providers, not the live service.
Six scenarios share four distinct pytest nodes; these are not six independent live trials.
